LESSON: CHRISTIAN MARRIAGE AND FAMILY

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian Living Today
Topic 6.2: Christian Marriage and Family

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Christian Marriage and Family
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How does a good marriage contribute to stability in the society?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. discuss the biblical teachings on marriage and family
2. explain ways the church promotes values among young people before marriage
3. identify values needed to maintain stability in families
4. appreciate the family as a sacred institution ordained by God
